status.notConnectedNow: Messages to guests go out by email, if set up.

meta.notSubscribed: The number sends, but Meta did not subscribe the app to the account: guest messages won't arrive. Connect again with the right token.
meta.formHint: All three values are in the Meta console, under WhatsApp › API Setup.
meta.tokenHint: Prefer a system user token: it doesn't expire. Stored encrypted.
meta.disconnectConfirm: From now on messages to guests go out by email. The number stays on Meta.

templates.hint: Without an active template the message goes out by SMS or email.
templates.hintMeta: Meta approves them, usually within minutes. Without an active template the message goes by email.
templates.send: Send the missing ones to Meta
templates.sendError: Meta did not accept the templates

agent.modeOffHint: It works only when you press the wand in Messages.
agent.modeDraftHint: For every message it prepares the reply: you find it ready to send in Messages.
agent.modeReplyHint: It replies on its own. Changes to bookings still need your confirmation: you get a notification.

limit.staff_quiet_minutes: Stays quiet if staff wrote within (minutes)

agent.simHint: Write as a guest: the agent replies as it would on the real number, without sending anything. Bookings don't change.
agent.simPlaceholder: E.g. Are you open tonight? We are 4
agent.modeActionsHint: Replies and, where the rules allow, books, moves and cancels on its own. Every action reaches you as a notification and can be undone from the chat.
agent.autoTitle: What it does on its own
agent.autoRules: What is off, it proposes. Always left to staff: deposits, banquets, large groups, room changes and bookings too close.

reminders.hint: The reminder comes with "We'll be there", "I need to change" and "Cancel". "Cancel" asks for confirmation and respects the notice period of "Your booking". When it is sent is set in Bookings › Reminders.
reminders.templateMissing: pending: until it is active the usual reminder is sent

entry.noNumber: Connect a WhatsApp number first: the link points to it.
entry.copyFailed: Not copied: select it by hand

media.transcribeHint: In Messages the voice note also appears written, and the agent reads it as a message. Uses Sofia's ElevenLabs credits.
media.transcribeMissing: The ElevenLabs key is missing on the server: transcription cannot run.
media.photosHint: The agent looks at the photos the customer sends (up to three per reply): a booking screenshot, a ticket, a menu.

takeawayChat.toggleHint: In chat it shows the menu, offers the free pickup times and, after the customer says yes, records the order on the board. Takeaway rules apply: capacity, stop and preparation time.
takeawayChat.ready: Notify when the order is ready
takeawayChat.readyHint: When the order goes to "Ready" (from the counter or the kitchen monitor) the customer gets a WhatsApp. Outside the 24 hours the "Takeaway order ready" template is needed.

campaigns.created: Campaign saved: check it and start it
campaigns.estimateChanged: The recipients have changed: check the amount and try again
campaigns.needLegal: The advanced legal mode is required (Settings › Privacy).
campaigns.needEnabled: Turn on campaigns in Settings › WhatsApp › Campaigns.
campaigns.needTemplate: The campaign template is not approved by Meta yet.
campaigns.spent: Spent this month: {{speso}} of {{tetto}}. One message costs about {{unit}}. Sending from {{da}} to {{a}}, never twice to the same number within {{giorni}} days.
campaigns.name: Name (only you see it)
campaigns.messagePlaceholder: E.g. Friday 24th truffle dinner, €45 per person. Reply here to book.
campaigns.messageHint: It arrives as "Hi Mario, some news from [restaurant name]: …", with the "Stop promotions" button.
campaigns.rules: Only customers who agreed to promotions, never those who said STOP, are blacklisted or had a no-show in the last 90 days.

campaignsPolicy.hint: Campaigns are created in Messages › Campaigns. They only reach those who agreed to promotions (also via the box on /prenota and /ordina); whoever replies STOP gets nothing more. The advanced legal mode is required.
campaignsPolicy.pause: Days between two campaigns to the same number
